name: Improved Martial Focus
body:
Your commitment to the martial arts rivals that of even the most fearsome fighters.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +5, Martial Focus

Benefit: Choose one fighter weapon group. While wielding a weapon from this group with which you are proficient, you gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls. When your base attack bonus reaches +9, and every 4 points thereafter, this bonus and the bonus granted by the Martial Focus feat increase by +1.

Special: The Improved Martial Focus feat counts as the weapon training class feature with the chosen fighter weapon group. Your weapon training bonus is equal to the bonus granted by this feat.
